sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production standalone transparent 2D tower-defense sprite. Input is the level-1 tower, edit target and strict family reference. Make LEVEL 2 of the SAME tower. Keep the exact elevated three-quarter front camera, orientation, round wide copper pedestal diameter, navy metal, warm amber lighting, thick outline, hand-painted cartoon style, image occupancy and ground contact of the reference. Full single object centered, square transparent canvas, no scenery, no text, no labels. IMPORTANT do not change tower species or replace base with angular feet; it must be recognizably the same tower upgraded, compact chunky body and big details legible at 32px. Preserve single forward cannon barrel and two round amber side lights. Upgrade with thicker navy shoulder armor, a strong copper barrel reinforcement collar and a pair of small armored side vents. Keep pedestal and body just as broad and visually large as original, height nearly the same. No detached sparks outside silhouette.
